newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo moves towards regional structure.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo moves towards regional structure.

text.p: Drugs giant Glaxo Wellcome Plc said on Thursday it had taken the first steps towards setting up a worldwide regional structure to take advantage of changing opportunities in the pharmaceutical industry.

In a statement, deputy chairman and chief executive Sir Richard Sykes said the decision to set up five new business regions was the outcome of a major strategic review following the integration of Glaxo and Wellcome.
The new regional structures centre on Asia Pacific, Japan, Latin America, North America and, as one grouping, Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
Sykes said the changes would lead to "a greater emphasis on regional and local decision making".
Managers will be responsible for maximising Glaxo Wellcome's opportunities in each region.
"The essential purpose is to capitlise on the diversity of business opportunities around the world, a world in which the balance of economic opportunity is shifting rapidly," Sykes added.
